product_metadata.title: 84" Long Sheer Curtain Panel - Rust
features: This Picture shows two Sheer Panels and a sheer scarf. This Package contains one Sheer Panel.
Curtains have a rod pocket insert that create a clean, tailored look
For a full look use 2 panels to cover a standard size window (23" to 36" wide window)
Allows natural light to flow through the room
Machine washable in cold water (gentle cycle) and line dry. Iron on lowest setting if needed.
description: This package contains one (1) piece 84 inch long sheer curtain. The picture shows 2 curtains and 1 window scarf. The curtain is approximately 56” wide. For standard size windows (23 to 36 inches wide), it is recommended that you use 2 packages. This curtain has a rod pocket for easy hanging. These curtains will accent any room in your house. They allow natural light to filter into your room. 100% polyester. Can be machine washed in cold water (gentle cycle) and line dry. Iron on lowest setting if needed.
